html: Regular, good-quality sleep supports mood, concentration and overall health. Most adults do best with seven or more hours a night.

image.caption: A cool, dark, quiet room can make it easier to fall asleep.
image.title: Illustration of a crescent moon over a calm bedroom window

html:
• Keep a consistent sleep and wake time, even on weekends
  • Limit caffeine later in the day
  • Put screens away before bed
  • Build a short wind-down routine
Talk with a health care professional if trouble sleeping lasts for weeks, or if you snore loudly or feel very sleepy during the day.
